# follow: written by build.sh from toys/follow.y; do not edit.
level left T
level left HIGH
rule 0 s: X e T Z
rule 1 s: Y e
rule 2 s: Y f
rule 3 e: W %prec HIGH
rule 4 f: W T Z
refuse	-	X
refuse	-	Y
refuse	-	X W
accept	3:1-2,1:0-2	Y W
refuse	-	X W T
refuse	-	Y W T
accept	3:1-2,0:0-4	X W T Z
accept	4:1-4,2:0-4	Y W T Z
